intro: Welcome to Echo Island. Four precious gems are waiting to be found. They open an ancient door hiding the treasure. Follow the lanterns, meet the islanders, and discover the treasure together.

elara.name: Elara
elara.greeting: Hello, traveller! Welcome to my library. I have a letter for you.
elara.task: Take a look at my bookshelves. The markings and shelf positions will help you find the book from my letter.
elara.success: Lovely work! Here is a precious emerald for the cave door. The trail continues at Milo's workshop.
elara.wrong: Not quite. Take your time, and check the clues in my letter again.
elara.reward: You found the golden-feather book. Elara gives you an emerald, the green jewel of the cave seal.

milo.name: Milo
milo.greeting: Hi there! I'm Milo. My little clock could use an explorer's help.
milo.task: Pick up a coloured gear from the tray on the left, then choose a numbered socket to place it. You can pick up placed gears or swap them. The clock starts as soon as the order is right.
milo.success: There we go! The clock is ticking again. This precious ruby is yours. Nia is waiting at the market.
milo.wrong: Not quite. We can give it another try. Check the order in my letter.
milo.reward: The clock is ticking again. Milo opens its little drawer and gives you a polished crimson ruby.

nia.name: Nia
nia.greeting: Welcome to the market! I'm Nia. Come and take a look at my delivery map.
nia.task: Press E to pick up my parcel. Use W A S D to walk across the wooden bridge. Then approach the delivery box outside the riverside cottage and press E again.
nia.success: A delivery well done! Here is a royal-blue sapphire. Follow the path to Ori at the ancient temple.
nia.wrong: That is another cottage. The parcel is still safe. Have another look at my letter.
nia.reward: The parcel reached the riverside cottage. Nia thanks you with a sparkling sapphire.

ori.name: Ori
ori.greeting: Hello, fellow explorer. I'm Ori. These old symbols have a story to tell.
ori.task: Press the carved symbols on the three stone pillars. Each correct symbol lights up, and the altar opens when the sequence is complete. The markings above the entrance show the order. There is no need to hurry.
ori.success: The symbols have answered. Take this amethyst, the final jewel. Place all four gems into the matching sockets on the treasure cave door.
ori.wrong: The altar is ready for another try. Follow the order from my letter.
ori.reward: Sun, wave, star. The altar opens, and Ori gives you a violet amethyst, the final gem needed to unlock the cave.
